ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution covering approximately 85-90% of the visible fluke area, with high-intensity (white) pixels forming localized linear and cluster-based features.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large-scale contiguous dark region forming the base pigmentation; high-contrast white linear pixel paths crisscrossing the central and lateral lobes; high-intensity ovoid clusters concentrated on the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow U-shaped notch at the central axis with a calculated wide interior angle and moderate bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with variable pixel-amplitude peaks across the entire superior boundary; right lobe trailing edge exhibits more pronounced jaggedness than the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitted to the outer edges of the fluke lobes extending from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-intensity white circular and ovoid pixel clusters localized at the distal margins and tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of distinct, multi-directional white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) that overlay the primary dark pigmentation across both fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake-mark scarring and barnacle attachment clusters concentrated on the trailing edges and distal tips.
